It does not verify Vietnamese labels, blank-row semantics, schema IDs, accounting equations, Excel output, human-gold accuracy or untouched-holdout performance.
development_note: The 0.99 agreement, one-cell abstention and geometry-only 0.27-line-height bottom-canvas policy were selected after dirty calibration smoke tests on this block.
